en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhassin Bin Ahmad, from Aban Bin usman, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When a man sneezes three (times), so Name (Allah<sup>azwj</sup> in response) and leave him (if he sneezes any more)’.
en.sarwar: 27. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhsin ibn Ahmad from Aban ibn ‘Uthman from Zurara from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “
If one sneezes three times, the special expressions for this purpose should be said only up to three times and thereafter should be left alone.”
